name: Apache Commons Build Plugin Maven Mojo
description: Apache Maven Mojo for Apache Commons Build tasks. For example: mvn commons-build:download-page [-Dcommons.release.version=1.2.3] To use a SNAPSHOT version (for testing and so on): mvn org.apache.commons:commons-build-plugin:1.14.0-SNAPSHOT:download-page [-Dcommons.release.version=1.2.3]
